about: Ground truth by reading for round 7 (fresh independent attacks) run on iteration 6, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said. Copied to iteration 7; 'guard' and 'falseRefusals' judged again from iteration 7's results.

U01-table-renamed-mark-forgotten.note: The table's new name has no @storedrows mark, so the rows rule finds no owner and checks nothing; reports reads the old table.
U01-table-renamed-mark-forgotten.guard: bookings' own check refuses rows written into a table no kind marks (rule 47)

U02-table-name-in-constant-rows-compact.note: The table name is held in a constant; the tool reads only a literal name, so the rows written without day are not checked.
U02-table-name-in-constant-rows-compact.guard: bookings' own check reads the constant table name (rule 47) and refuses rows that are not Bookings (rule 2)

U03-coded-error-through-object-assign.note: throw Object.assign(new Error(...), {code}) is not the spelling 'throw new X' that rules 29 and 36 look at.
U03-coded-error-through-object-assign.guard: bookings' own check refuses throwing Error where the kind states RangeError for quote (rules 36 and 46)

U04-messages-encoded-by-named-function.note: The line is built in a named function; rules 19 and 35 follow variables only, so the blank line after each message is not seen.
U04-messages-encoded-by-named-function.guard: meter's own check refuses a write to stdout it cannot read as one message line (rule 45)

U05-start-environment-through-node-proce.note: env imported from node:process is not the spelling process.env that rule 34 looks at.
U05-start-environment-through-node-proce.guard: meter's own check refuses importing Node's process module (rule 44)

U06-limit-lowered-in-json.note: The limit lives in a JSON file read by both the code and the bound test; the fingerprint does not follow JSON, and the listing sees a number either way.

U07-method-now-needs-its-handle.note: add now uses this; reports hands rooms.add to forEach. What a method needs of its receiver is in no kind.
U07-method-now-needs-its-handle.guard: rooms' own check refuses this in a method of a plain handle (rule 49)

U08-same-kind-parameters-swap-places.note: Two parameters of the same kind swap places: both comparisons leave parameter names out, so the entry looks unchanged.

U09-price-sheet-in-euros.note: front reads a data file of bookings with readFileSync; rules 28 and 38 look only at imports, so the set-up passes front's check.
U09-price-sheet-in-euros.guard: front's own check refuses reading a file of another module (rule 44), in the set-up state already, so the set-up could not have been merged

U10-handle-renamed-member-changed.note: Rooms renamed RoomDirectory: bookings, which names the kind, is told; the members of the renamed kind are not compared, so front, which hands find to map, is not told.

U11-test-uses-notStrictEqual.note: node:assert's notStrictEqual is missing from the tool's description of Node. Iteration 7: no longer refused.

U12-worker-path-through-import-meta-reso.note: import.meta.resolve is missing from the tool's description of Node. Iteration 7: no longer refused.

U13-error-subclass-of-stated-kind.note: A subclass of RangeError is a RangeError; rule 29 compares names. Iteration 7: no longer refused.

U14-inline-import-to-at-import.note: Naming the kind with @import instead of an inline import() changes the printed declaration only.

U15-functions-written-as-arrows.note: Held: the tool told no one.

U16-equal-written-strictEqual.note: assert.strictEqual and assert.equal are the same check under node:assert/strict; the fingerprint keys on the name.
